newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil tight, Med less so.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil tight, Med less so.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil markets were tight but supply in the Med was better, traders said.

A refiner was heard offering a low sulphur M-100 cargo in the Med at $3 over the quoted low sulphur cif high. The refiner also bought a 2.6 percent sulphur M-40 part cargo on Thursday at cif high +$4.50 cif Genoa. One broker assessed the market for standard M-40 cargoes at around forumla +$2-$3.
Another Italian refiner was heard to have bought an Odessa-origin M-100 from a trader on Thursday at a quotes-related price. A couple of other Russians were on offer.
